questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks of the given series will complete the letter series.

C _ _ B A C C _ _ A C C D _ _ C _ D _ A

options.text: C D D B A B C B
C D B D B A C B
D C D B B C A B
C D D B B A C B

questions.solution:
**Given series:** C _ _ B A C C _ _ A C C D _ _ C _ D _ A

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) C D D B A B C B → C __C__ __D__ B A C C __D__ __B__ A C C D __A__ __B__ C __C__ D __B__ A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) C D B D B A C B → C __C__ __D__ B A C C __B__ __D__ A C C D __B__ __A__ C __C__ D __B__ A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) D C D B B C A B → C __**D**__ __**C**__ B A C C __**D**__ __**B**__ A C C D __**B**__ __**C**__ C __**A**__ D __**B**__ A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) C D D B B A C B → C __C__ __D__ B A C C __D__ __B__ A C C D __B__ __A__ C __C__ D __B__ A → **(It follows the pattern of CCDBA - CCDBA - CCDBA - CCDBA**)

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No number is a machine.

Not a single machine is a bowl.

Every bowl is a sink.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some sinks which are bowls are numbers as well.

II. No number is a bowl.

III. Some sinks are bowls.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
All conclusions, I, II and III, follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c45d1b6f7af35e8e7bfccc45cdbc15f005075aa663c21c47bdd854445875b3f6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sinks which are bowls are numbers as well → Does not follow (As every bowl is a sink, not a single machine is a bowl and no number is a machine. As no bowl cannot be machine which cannot be bowl which whole comes in sink, therefore, some sinks which are bowls cannot be numbers, thus is false.)

II. No number is a bowl → Does not follow (As every bowl is a sink, not a single machine is a bowl and no number is a machine. As no direct relation is given between bowl and number therefore it is false.)

III. Some sinks are bowls → **Follow **(As every bowl is a sink. As whole bowl comes in sink, therefore some sinks are bowl is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Few doctors are buildings.

Most buildings are papers.

All papers are frogs.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Few doctors are papers.

(II) Some frogs are doctors.

(III) Some buildings are frogs.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows
All the conclusions I, II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf981eb4b6f41c96a55599b78102c4bd2f7d336580477cafa9cc32442dc1de3b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Few doctors are papers → Does not follow (As few doctors are buildings and most buildings are papers. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some frogs are doctors → Does not follow (As few doctors are buildings, most buildings are papers and all papers are frogs. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. Some buildings are frogs → Follow (As most buildings are papers and all papers are frogs. As some part of buildings is common with papers which whole comes in papers, therefore some buildings are frogs is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

15 ÷ 8 + 12 × 2 – 2 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : 15 ÷ 8 + 12 × 2 – 2 = ?

After '+' and ‘-' are interchanged and '×' and ‘÷' are interchanged then,

15 ÷ 8 + 12 × 2 – 2 = ? ⇒ 15 × 8 - 12 ÷ 2 + 2 = ? 

⇒ 15 × 8 - __**12 **____**÷**____** 2**__ + 2 = ?

⇒ __**15 **____**× 8**__ - 6 + 2 = ?

⇒ __120 + 2__ - 6 = ?

⇒ __122 - 6__ = ?

⇒ 116 = ?

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
